connect.title: Connect to the server
connect.description: This PC isn't connected to the gym's server yet. Choose the server below or type its address.
connect.thisPcHint: The gym's server runs on this PC.
connect.noneFound: No server was found. Type its address.
connect.addressHint: For example 192.168.1.20; it is shown on the server's screen.
connect.notFound: No server answers at this address.
connect.noGym: A server without a gym yet
connect.identityHint: Make sure the server's screen shows the same identity. If it is different, don't connect, and tell your manager.
connect.codeHint: The 6-digit code made on the server's screen.

errors.code_expired: The code has expired. Make a new one on the server.
errors.no_code: There is no code in use. Make a new one on the server.
errors.too_many_tries: Too many tries. Wait a minute.
errors.invalid_name: Type a name for this PC.
errors.certificate_changed: The server showed another identity. Check it again.

connect.notThisPc: The gym's server doesn't run on this PC.

setup.title: Server setup
setup.licenseDescription: This server has no license yet. Send the machine code to Click Group; they send you a license code and an activation code.
setup.ownerDescription: The gym's first account: its Owner. They get a temporary password and choose their own at the first login.
setup.passwordHint: This password is shown only now. Give it to the gym's Owner.

errors.license_other_gym: This license is for another gym.
errors.license_older: This license is older than the one already in.
errors.license_needed: Put the license code in first.
errors.activation_other_gym: The activation code is for another gym.
errors.activation_other_machine: The activation code is for another PC.
errors.owner_exists: The gym's Owner was already created.

setup.copyFailed: Couldn't copy; select it and copy it yourself.

page.title: Server
page.description: The gym's PCs connect to this server.
page.codeHint: Type this code on the new PC and check that the identity is the same. It works until {{time}}.
page.removeText: This PC can't reach the server any more until it is connected again.
page.error: The server didn't answer. Try again.
